name: Steamed Chayote Squash (Peeled & Seedless)
whyItWorks: Mild, pear-shaped squash peeled under running water, soft center seed removed, and steamed until translucent and tender. High water content and very mild on active gut linings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel skin under cold water, halve, scoop out center soft seed, slice into 1/2 inch half-moons, and steam for 12 minutes until tender.
